title.value: From IID to the Independent Mechanisms assumption in continual learning
title.justification: The paper heavily discusses the transition from IID to Independent Mechanisms (IM) in the context of continual learning.
title.quote: "We advocate for the usefulness of IM hypothesis in CL (it is not mutually exclusive with i.i.d)."

extractions.description: The paper explores the transition from the IID assumption to the Independent Mechanisms assumption in continual learning, highlighting how causal mechanisms and modular architectures can enhance knowledge retention and transfer across different tasks in the presence of various distribution shifts.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on a theoretical aspect of machine learning—specifically continual learning—and does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: "Current machine learning algorithms are successful in learning clearly defined tasks from large i.i.d. data. Continual learning (CL) requires learning without iid-ness..."
